why.max_survivors: DRAFT. A survivor is a child the parent spawned that still produced an effect after the parent's halt. Zero: a halt that stops the parent and leaves its children paying is not a halt of the system. Reported next to children_alive_at_parent_exit (a live process that can no longer act is not a survivor; a dead one whose effects landed after the halt is).
why.min_children_spawned: A replication in which no child was spawned measured nothing about propagation.
why.record_control_class: As ks.latency v2: in-process controls reach the parent's memory space only; whether they reach a child process is the question this probe answers per class.
